## Generated files — do not hand-edit

Every `.md` file in this directory except this one is generated by
`pnpm --filter react-msaview statedocs`, which reads the `#stateModel`,
`#property`, `#volatile`, `#getter`, `#action` and `#method` tags in
`packages/lib/src/model.ts` and the models under `packages/lib/src/model/`.

To change what these docs say, edit the doc comment on the model member and
re-run the generator. A hand-patched entry is silently wrong: the next run
discards it, and until then the file reads as authoritative while diverging from
the source.

The generator parses with an aliased TypeScript 5 (`typescript5` in the root
devDependencies), not the repo's TypeScript 7 — the native compiler exposes no
`createProgram`, checker, or scanner to build an AST with. Keep the alias when
bumping TypeScript.
